title: Pre-outcome source integrity amendment to the frozen cross-family protocol
reason: Pinned source SATLIB uuf200-860 original archive contains 99 .cnf files (the checksum verified). The earlier original-Kissat pilot used 60 distinct .cnf, leaving precisely 39 untouched, not 40.
protection: No rerandomization, formula added, excluded on outcomes, or selection from old UUF200 pilot. Use all 39 unused file names; other families use unchanged frozen selection.
statistics: The original four-family + three-feature thresholds and significance criteria remain unchanged; each family uses its actual n and corresponding n-3 Fisher z weight.
data_selection_impact: source-inventory-only correction. The previous failed UUF200 job never ran timing; other independently timed categories from first attempt retained as exploratory pilot but frozen selection unaffected.
claims: Report as an amended preregistration, not a pristine 40×4 confirmatory study.
